reviews.title: Excellent replacement for my older PSU extension. Excellent for ATX 3.0 PSUs
reviews.comment: Was having GPU driver issues and found out it was my old extension that melted in the GPU connector. Had to vacuum out the pieces of the connector and clean out the connectors which took me an additional 25 minutes. These cables are higher quality and more flexible than my older 8 year old cables. The thickness isn't bad but if you have a small case it might be hard to cable manage. But overall can’t complain was able to play games without crashing so these cable helped save my PC.Needed to buy a new cable set anyways. Im on x870 Tomahawk so if you want two 8+8 pin extensions this set only comes with one so you will have to buy a seperate extension.
reviews.author: Maurice Anderson

reviews.title: Enhance Your PC Aesthetic with EZDIY-FAB PSU Extension Cable
reviews.comment: Firstly, the soft nylon braided material not only adds durability but also lends a sleek and professional look to the interior of my PC. The cables are flexible and easy to route, making cable management a breeze. The inclusion of the comb kit ensures that the cables stay neatly organized and aligned, enhancing the overall aesthetic appeal of my build. The 24PIN/8PIN/6PIN connectors provide compatibility with a wide range of power supplies and components, offering flexibility for various setups. Whether you're a PC enthusiast looking to showcase your rig or simply aiming for a clean and organized interior, these extension cables from EZDIY-FAB are a must-have. They're affordable, easy to install, and instantly elevate the appearance of any PC build. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Anthony bailey

reviews.title: High quality extensions!
reviews.comment: Pros: These are very high quality braided cables for the price. Not too stiff and flexible enough for me to place and align them accordingly and makes your pc build aesthetic look cleaner. Have used it for about a week playing games and doing tasks, and have no issues in performance and power stability. Cons: I'm honestly just nitpicking the cons. These extensions are somewhat long, however, I haven't used any other extension brands so I couldn't do any comparisons, but if you're using these for a small form factor, it's going to be a challenge cable managing with these extensions on.
